c74object.name: ambitap.doppler~
c74object.category: audio, ambisonics, spatial, delay, doppler, mc
c74object.digest: Variable propagation delay for a higher-order ambisonics bus
c74object.description: Variable propagation delay for a higher-order ambisonics bus. Modulate 'distance' for the Doppler effect. Order is a creation arg.

attribute.name: distance
attribute.description: Source-to-listener distance in meters. Modulate for Doppler.

attribute.name: max_distance
attribute.description: Maximum distance (sizes the delay buffer). Reallocates on change.
